answer: Give each new key a random public procurement invoice to reconcile against its award notice and delivery record, tagged with a nebula/beacon/vault nonce. An independent auditor signs the matched three-record hash; the registry consumes that invoice ID and rejects duplicates, altered totals or missing documents. Proposed review fee: .85 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .85 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,850 (1,000 × .85). Limitation: public records vary by region and auditors can collude.
